name: How do I compare room addition framing quotes without getting burned?
description: Compare scope, not just price. Make sure each quote includes the same framing details, structural work, and exclusions so you can see the real difference.

mainEntity.name: How do I compare room addition framing quotes without getting burned?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are comparing bids, focus on whether the contractor is quoting framing only or framing plus structural work, roofing tie-in, and inspection support. A lower bid can look attractive, but it may leave out critical items like headers, shear requirements, or cleanup of existing conditions. For homeowners in Denver, Centennial, Greenwood Village, Foxfield, and Parker, the best comparison is not just price; it is scope, materials, and whether the team has experience with addition framing in local conditions. Ask each bidder to explain what is excluded so you can compare fairly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare scope, not just price. Make sure each quote includes the same framing details, structural work, and exclusions so you can see the real difference.
